confidence_notes: Medium overall. Inexpensive and mid-range meal anchors rest on two Tottori-level cost-of-living aggregates (CityCost and almurakib.com) that broadly agree. Coffee and beer rest on national chain and Tokyo-level references, plus one Tottori nightlife cost page of unclear method, and the beer serving size is ambiguous. Cocktail and wine anchors are weakly sourced and were set from the beer anchor using a typical Japanese bar markup, because direct Tottori evidence was thin and conflicting. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and regional context; no booking pages or current listings were checked. Yen figures were converted to USD at approximate rates taken from the sources, not a July 2026 observation, and several sources are undated, so treat all values as planning ranges.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Meal anchors follow Tottori-level aggregates; coffee follows national Japanese chain and cafe pricing; beer, cocktail and wine reference Tokyo and other Japanese bar and restaurant listings, adjusted down for a smaller regional city; hostel and hotel anchors reflect regional Japanese guesthouse and business-hotel norms.
